Devshayani Ekadashi observed with religious rituals and observances

Devshayani Ekadashi, marking the beginning of Chaturmas and Lord Vishnu's four-month slumber, was observed. Devotees performed puja, offered specific items, and read religious stories. Information regarding auspicious timings, rituals for breaking the fast, and ways to seek blessings for prosperity was widely shared.
